newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Jurong Engineering proposes bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Jurong Engineering proposes bond issue.

text.p: Jurong Engineering Ltd said on Wednesday it proposed to issue Singapore $20 million of unsecured bonds due 2002 and 8.46 million detachable warrants.
Each warrant entitles the holder to subscribe for one new ordinary share of S$0.50 each in the company, it said in a statement.
The bonds without the warrants will be offered for sale by DBS Bank, the manager of the issue.
This will be done through private placement to institutional and other investors at a price to be determined by the bank.

The warrants without the bonds will be offered by DBS Bank to registered shareholders through a renounceable preferential offering on the basis of one warrant for every five existing ordinary shares of S$0.50 each.
Jurong Engineering intends to use the net proceeds of the issue to partially finance the group's sewage treatment works projects at Kranji and Ulu Pandan, the statement said.
The issue is subject to the approval of the Stock Exchange of Singapore and shareholders.
